variants.text: One long street of chimneys. Somebody laid this district out around the fire risk and the fire risk won.
Craftrow, and you can hear it before you turn into it: hammers on three different notes and somebody's grinding wheel under all of them.
Soot on the render, sparks going up somewhere behind the roofline, and every shopfront open to the street.
The trades that need heat, gathered where the wind takes it away from the rest of the city.
